english_retrieval.title: I'm Chelsea Clinton. Trump demolishes a house that isn't his | Opinion
english_retrieval.snippet: ## What was dismantled today isn't just marble or plaster; it is a reflection of how easily history can be erased when power forgets purpose. Although I spent many of my formative years living in the White House, I always knew it wasn’t my house. It was my home, absolutely, but not my house. The White House belongs to the American people, and that’s why we call it the People’s House. Eight years later, my family would welcome the Bush family back, and I remember telling Jenna and Barbara Bush about my favorite places, the friends I had made who worked at the White House and, yes, my favorite foods. It was the same sensibility I had when meeting Presidents Jimmy Carter, Gerald Ford and Richard Nixon as well as first ladies Jacqueline Kennedy and Lady Bird Johnson, and others who had, for a time, called the White House home.
